app.name: QR Cardápio
app.tagline: Elegant digital menu with a permanent QR Code
landing.page_title: QR Cardápio — Your digital menu with a permanent QR Code
landing.meta_description: Create a beautiful digital menu, generate your QR Code, and update products and prices whenever you want.
landing.hero_subtitle: Build a digital menu that looks like your business. Share it by QR code or link and update photos, prices, and items anytime.
landing.demo_badge: Dashboard and menu screens with sample data.
landing.how_title: From sign-up to table in three steps
landing.how_subtitle: Set up, review, and publish everything from your dashboard.
landing.step1_body: Enter your name, pick your brand accent color, and optionally upload a logo.
landing.step2_body: Organize your menu with photos, concise descriptions, and clear prices.
landing.step3_body: Download a print-ready QR code and share your menu link anywhere.
landing.benefit1_body: Set up from your phone or computer.
landing.benefit2_body: Use your own colors, logo, and photos.
landing.benefit3_body: Review changes in a draft before publishing.
landing.benefit4_body: Print once and keep the same code.
landing.cta_subtitle: Create an account and build your first digital menu.
landing.dashboard_alt: Portuguese dashboard with sidebar navigation, product and category totals, and publishing actions.
landing.phone_alt: Portuguese mobile menu for a fictional bistro with a cover photo, categories, and prices.
auth.login_subtitle: Manage menu items, update prices, or download your QR Code.
auth.register_subtitle: Start for free and publish your digital menu today.
auth.reset_subtitle: Enter the recovery token provided by support and choose a new password.
auth.forgot_help: During the pilot phase, request a recovery token from an administrator and open /reset-password.
onboarding.heading: Let's set up your establishment
onboarding.subtitle: Choose how your business appears at the top of the menu and in your permanent QR link.
onboarding.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Once published, this address is locked to keep printed QR Codes valid.
onboarding.description_placeholder: e.g. Specialty coffee, fresh pastries, and desserts.
dashboard.heading: Menu overview
dashboard.confirm_unpublish: Unpublish this menu? Guests scanning the QR Code will see an unavailable page until you publish again.
dashboard.empty_hint: Add categories and items to start building your menu.
dashboard.subtitle: Manage your menu and see what’s live.
menu_editor.heading: Your Menu
menu_editor.subtitle: Organize categories, add items, and toggle what is available today.
menu_editor.empty_body: Start by creating a category such as "Burgers", "Drinks", or "Desserts".
menu_editor.empty_products: No items in this category yet.
menu_editor.confirm_delete_category: Deleting this category will also remove all items inside it. Continue?
menu_editor.confirm_delete_product: Delete this item from your menu?
menu_editor.publish_banner: You have unpublished menu edits. Publish whenever you are ready to update the live QR menu.
category_form.description_placeholder: Optional. e.g. Freshly pressed seasonal juices.
category_form.visible_label: Show this category on the public menu
product_form.image_hint: JPG, PNG, or WebP up to 5 MB.
product_form.visible_label: Show this item on the public menu
settings.heading: Establishment identity
settings.subtitle: Customize the name, description, accent color, and logo shown on your menu.
settings.logo_hint: PNG, JPG, or WebP up to 2 MB. Automatically resized.
settings.slug_locked_note: This URL has been published and is locked so printed QR Codes always stay valid.
qr.heading: Your permanent QR Code
qr.subtitle: Print it once. Every price or item update you publish automatically appears at this exact QR Code.
qr.not_published_warning: Heads up: your menu is still a draft. Publish it before placing QR Codes on tables.
qr.tip_1: Print at least 3 cm × 3 cm (1.2 in) on tables or counters.
qr.tip_2: Keep the white margin around the code clear and uncropped.
qr.tip_3: Test scanning with your own smartphone camera before laminating.
print.scan_cta: Point your phone camera to view our menu
print.helper: For best results, print on sturdy cardstock (180gsm+) and avoid cropping the white border.
public_menu.preview_banner: Preview mode — unpublished edits. Only visible to you.
public_menu.empty_menu: This menu is currently being prepared.
public_menu.no_results: No menu items match your search.
public_menu.not_found_body: This address does not exist or the establishment has not published its menu yet.
admin.heading: Operations dashboard
admin.subtitle: Track businesses, live menus, and publishing history.
flash.registered: Account created! Let's configure your establishment.
flash.password_reset: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
flash.establishment_created: Establishment created! Now add your first category.
flash.published: Menu published! Your QR Code now serves the latest version.
flash.unpublished: Menu unpublished and returned to draft mode.
flash.ocr_extracted: Extraction complete! Review detected items before confirming pre-registration.
flash.ocr_applied: Pre-registration complete! Items were added to your draft menu.
ocr.heading: Pre-register from Photo or PDF (OCR)
ocr.subtitle: Upload a menu photo or PDF to automatically extract categories, items, and prices for review.
ocr.upload_label: Choose an image or PDF file
ocr.upload_drop_hint: Drag and drop your file here, or click to browse
ocr.upload_formats: JPG, PNG, or WebP photos (up to 10 MB) or PDF (up to 15 MB, max 8 pages).
ocr.processing: Scanning menu... please wait a few seconds.
ocr.tip_1: If you have the original PDF (Canva, Word, or print file), upload the PDF for near-100% accuracy.
ocr.tip_2: For photos, shoot straight-on in bright lighting and avoid shadows over prices.
ocr.tip_3: Nothing goes live automatically: you review and edit every item before saving to draft.
ocr.paste_placeholder:
e.g.
DRINKS
Fresh Orange Juice ....... R$ 12.00
Double Espresso .......... R$ 9.50
ocr.review_subtitle: Adjust categories, names, descriptions, and prices. Confirmed items are saved to your draft menu.
ocr.review_readonly_note: This import has already been finalized and is read-only.
ocr.opt_reuse_categories: Reuse existing categories with matching names
ocr.opt_mark_visible: Mark imported items visible when publishing
ocr.confirm_discard: Discard this OCR draft without importing any items?
ocr.no_rows_hint: No items were detected automatically. Add rows manually below or upload a sharper photo.
ocr.warn_no_items: No priced items were detected automatically. Check the raw text below or try another file.
ocr.warn_missing_prices: Some items had no detected price. Enter a price (e.g. 19.90) or uncheck them before confirming.
ocr.warn_scanned_pdf: This PDF contained image-only pages and was read using OCR. Double-check accents and prices.
ocr.warn_low_text: Very little readable text was found in this image. Check lighting and sharpness.
ocr.warn_limited_langs: Portuguese Tesseract language data is not installed on this server; please verify accents before confirming.

error.ocr_timeout: Extraction timed out. Try fewer pages or a smaller photo.

error.ocr_pdf_failed: Could not read this PDF. Make sure it is not password-protected or corrupted.

error.ocr_no_selected_items: Select at least one valid item to confirm pre-registration.

status.missing_body: Check the address or return to the home page.

settings.google_maps_hint: Paste your business's sharing link from Google Maps. With this field alone, the invitation opens your profile.
settings.google_review_hint: If you have the review request link from your Business Profile, paste it here. Save and publish your menu to activate the invitation.
settings.google_help: How to get your Google review link
error.invalid_google_maps_link: Use a valid HTTPS link from Google Maps or Google Business Profile.
public_menu.google_review_body: Share your experience to help people who haven't visited yet.
maps.heading: Connect your menu to Google Maps
maps.subtitle: After a visit, invite customers to review your business from the menu. Add a profile or review link and publish to show the invitation.
maps.storefront_alt: Brasa 128 burger restaurant with a yellow awning and a blue door.
guide.title: Page guide
guide.business_name: Use the name customers recognize. It appears at the top of the menu.
guide.slug: Choose the last part of the link. Once published, the address is locked so the QR code keeps working.
guide.business_description: Introduce your business in a few sentences. The description appears under its name.
guide.color: Choose the main color for menu buttons, categories, and highlights.
guide.google_profile: Paste your business's Google Maps sharing link. The menu uses this address when you leave the direct review link empty.
guide.google_review: Paste the review request link to send guests directly to Google. Then save and publish your menu.
guide.logo: Select your brand image and upload it. Publish to update the public menu.
guide.translate_en: Enter the English version of this field. If you leave it blank, the menu uses the Portuguese text.
guide.translate_es: Enter the Spanish version of this field. If you leave it blank, the menu uses the Portuguese text.
guide.save: Save your changes as a draft. Publish from Overview to show them to customers.
guide.setup: Finish setting up your business to start building your menu.
guide.category_name: Name the group of items, for example Coffee, Snacks, or Desserts.
guide.category_description: Add a short description to introduce the items in this category.
guide.visible: Check to include this content in the next publication. Uncheck to keep it in the dashboard only.
guide.choose_category: Choose the category where this product will appear.
guide.product_name: Use a short name that identifies the dish or drink.
guide.price: Enter the price in Brazilian reais, for example 19.90.
guide.product_description: Describe ingredients and details that help customers choose the product.
guide.image: Use a sharp photo of the product. The dashboard accepts JPG, PNG, and WebP.
guide.remove_image: Check to remove the current photo when you save the product.
guide.available: Uncheck when the product is temporarily unavailable. If visibility is enabled, it stays visible with a notice.
guide.overview_counts: Check how many categories and products you have and see the published version.
guide.public_link: Copy this address to share your menu in a message or on social media.
guide.publish: Publish the changes saved in the dashboard. The link and QR code stay the same.
guide.preview: Open the preview to check your menu and draft changes before publishing.
guide.checklist: Use this checklist to see what remains before going live.
guide.admin_stats: See totals for accounts, businesses, live menus, and publication records.
guide.admin_businesses: Check the latest businesses, their addresses, states, and versions.
guide.admin_publications: Follow publication history and see which entries succeeded or failed.
guide.add_category: Start by creating categories to organize the menu by product type.
guide.add_product: Add a product with a name, category, price, and optional photo.
guide.import_menu: Open import to draft products from a PDF, photo, or text.
guide.edit_menu: Here you can edit, reorder, delete, and manage the availability of categories and products.
guide.qr_code: This code points to your permanent link. Scan it with your phone camera to check the destination.
guide.svg: Download SVG for sharp printing at different sizes.
guide.png: Download PNG for sharing as an image or using it where this format is required.
guide.print: Open the print-ready sheet and choose paper and size in the browser.
guide.ocr_file: Upload a readable photo or PDF. Check the extracted items before importing them.
guide.ocr_text: Paste your menu text, with an item and price on each line where possible.
guide.ocr_stats: Check the source and the counts of detected and selected items.
guide.ocr_select: Select the items you want to keep. Add a row if a dish was missed.
guide.ocr_rows: Review the category, name, price, description, and availability in each row.
guide.ocr_options: Choose whether to reuse existing categories and whether items will be visible when you publish.
guide.ocr_apply: Import selected items into the draft. You can still review changes before publishing.
guide.ocr_include: Check this row to import the product, or uncheck to skip it.
guide.ocr_reuse: Check to reuse existing categories with the same name.
guide.unpublish: Use this when you need to take the menu offline. The same QR code works again after you republish.
settings.publish_hint: Publish the menu to show these changes to customers.
forms.one_file: Choose one file at a time.
forms.invalid_type: Choose a file in one of the listed formats.
forms.invalid_size: The file exceeds the size limit for this field.
